story.title: Dallas Cowboys to light AT&T Stadium red for Salvation Army Red Kettle milestone
story.summary: AT&T Stadium will glow red Nov. 23 as the Dallas Cowboys celebrate 30 years with The Salvation Army Red Kettle campaign. The Dallas Cowboys will bathe AT&T Stadium in Arlington in red light to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the team's partnership with The Salvation Army's Red Kettle campaign. The team announced plans for a first-of-its-kind lighting ceremony on Monday, Nov. 23, just three days before the Cowboys' annual Thanksgiving Day game, when the team and The Salvation Army will kick off the charity's holiday fundraising campaign during a nationally televised halftime show. "Four generations of the Gene and Jerry Jones family will come together to illuminate the exterior of AT&T Stadium red in recognition of the milestone anniversary and the organizations' longstanding commitment to serving individuals and families in need," the team said.
